title: Port the TUI to Charm v2
lead:
Move internal/tui and cmd/ork from the github.com/charmbracelet v1 modules
to charm.land v2 (bubbletea, lipgloss, bubbles) before S12 adds screens
(`stack.charm-major`).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** new screens, behavior changes, or any other dependency.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Porting now touches one screen; after S12 and the Waves screens it touches
all of them.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The existing S11 tests and golden views pass unchanged on v2; any golden
  difference is explained in the report and approved by the reviewer.
- `go.mod` requires only the three v2 modules directly, and no v1 Charm module remains.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Read each v2 module's LICENSE and every new transitive module's from the
  module cache and update NOTICE; stop and report on anything not
  GPL-3.0-compatible (`stack.go-deps`, `stack.localereader`).
- Follow the upstream v2 upgrade guides; keep behavior identical.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .` clean; SPDX headers.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner runs `ork` and sees the same screen.
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit: "S15: port the TUI to Charm v2".
